notes.title: Steam Awards!
notes.content:
Heyho everybody!
We hope you enjoy yourself diving deep into Shadow Tactics: Aiko's Choice!

It's once again the time of the year! The autumn sale is in full swing and comes with its annual celebration of video games: The Steam Awards.

And that's where you come in.
We're proud of the work we put into Aiko's Choice and obviously feel that it is the best game ever developed - and if you only think the slightest bit alike, nominating us only makes perfect sense, right? 

These are the awards for which we feel most eligible:

[list]
[*] Best Game on the Go (VERIFIED for Steam Deck)
[*] Best Game You Suck At (Quicksave is your best friend)
[*] Best Soundtrack (First orchestral version of the Shadow Tactics theme)
[*] Outstanding Story-Rich Game (Because it's exactly what you needed after Shadow Tactics)
[/list]

If you prefer to nominate us for other awards, that's great as well!
Thank you so much for your support and your help with nominating us for the Steam Awards!

Team Daedalic Entertainment

notes.title: Aiko's Choice is live!
notes.content:
[h3]Konnichi wa friends,[/h3]

[u][b]Aiko's Choice is available NOW![/b][/u]

[previewyoutube=ZMR7iWpP6ds;full][/previewyoutube]

We're so happy to finally return to Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun and to celebrate the five years anniversary of Shadow Tactics with this expansion. We hope that you can feel the passion and joy that we put into this - for example, our composer Filippo Beck Peccoz created brand new music for Aiko's Choice with an real life orchestra!

And it really shows: The first time listening to the soundtrack and the orchestral main theme will give you full-on goosebumps - guaranteed. 

So, sharpen your shurikens ... and join us on another adventure to Japan, early Edo period!
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1579380/Shadow_Tactics_Blades_of_the_Shogun__Aikos_Choice/

If you have some questions, maybe they are already ansswered in our Developer Q&A Video - and if not, it still gives a great insight in the thoughts behind making this expansion.

[previewyoutube=MgGtYfdVL_A;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
Konnichiwa, everyone!

Celebrating the 5th anniversary of Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun, standalone expansion Aiko´s Choice releases December 6th 2021

The standalone expansion of the critically acclaimed RTT game Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun continues the story around the beloved group of assassins...

We are thrilled to finally announce the release date of Aiko’s Choice, the long-awaited standalone expansion for the acclaimed real-time tactics game Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun. On December 6th 2021, marking the 5th anniversary of the release of the original game, players will once again be sent to the ancient capital of Japan, Edo. There they will accompany the kunoichi adept Aiko and her deadly assassin friends to hunt down the ghosts of her past.

The new trailer sets the mood for Aiko’s Choice by summarizing the events of the main game (potential spoiler): 

[previewyoutube=GPxtAQxgpJo;full][/previewyoutube]

Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun - Aiko´s Choice focuses on one of the main game's protagonists: the kunoichi adept Aiko. She is a master of camouflage and distracts enemies disguised as a geisha. While Aiko was certain that she left her old life behind, her former sensei, the cunning spymaster Lady Chiyo, reappears from the shadows to challenge her. Together with her friends, a group of deadly assassins, she sets out to hunt down the ghosts of her past.

The expansion features three full-fledged main missions, set in brand-new environments, and three shorter interlude missions.

Like in the main game, you take control of a team of lethal specialists, move in the shadows and sneak past dozens of enemies. Choose your approach wisely when infiltrating hidden forest camps or lively Edo-period towns. Set traps, poison and distract your opponents – or avoid enemy contact altogether. Carefully plan your every move and come up with your own ingenious tactics to vanquish enemies and complete each of the challenging missions to uncover Aiko´s past.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1579380/Shadow_Tactics_Blades_of_the_Shogun__Aikos_Choice/

Features:

[list]
[*] Return to the beautiful world of Shadow Tactics set in Japan in the early Edo period.
[*] Rejoin your favorite characters for another adventure set within the story of the main game Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun.
[*] Experience a previously untold tale centered around the kunoichi adept Aiko, who has to face a vicious enemy connected to her past.
[*] Explore three full-fledged main missions, located in brand-new environments, and three shorter interlude missions.
[/list]

The expansion includes all the features of the main game:
[list]
[*] Play a team of completely different characters with their own unique skill sets.
[*] Synchronize your team's actions to strike down your enemies at once with the "Shadow Mode" feature.
[*] Choose between non-lethal or deadly stealth attacks.
[*] Find dozens of ways to take out or sneak past your opponents the way you want.
[*] Choose from three difficulty levels to match your skill.
[/list]
